# Changed-file interaction adaptation

Reference revision: 4878cdabd87d4041bdaff61d04c966883b9fd07a, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 DeepSeek. The reference checkout is unmodified. SOURCE.json records the exact files and hashes.

- ChangedFiles: single-file header and multi-file rows preview after 500ms; four rows before expansion; header opens index 0 and rows open the original summary index. Binary, oversized and deleted files can open comparisons. Current-file opening is a separate Review action.
- HoverCard: preview anchored to the outer card width minus 48px, 24px inset, 8px gap/viewport margin, 420px height, above/below placement; 200ms pointer grace and 100ms fade; window Escape and anchor press dismiss; scroll/resize/ResizeObserver update placement. The positioning formula is adapted in change-preview-position.ts; React lifetime/timers are implemented locally. The existing Friend topbar determines frame clearance.
- FileDiff/ReviewTab: lazy reads shared by hover and right workbench, inline unwrapped hover, split unwrapped review by default with clipped columns and synchronized scrolling, selected original index, loading/missing/error/retry/binary states, and a 5,000-line render bound. Existing Friend Diff row rendering is reused, with explicit green additions and red deletions.
- Data boundary: DSH captures turn-start/end Git trees and uncovered file-tool mutations, keeping summaries/comparison sources until Session disposal. Friend-Pi retains its existing Git interval baseline and Pi run lifecycle. To support its already-persisted history summaries, bounded frozen patches are stored in the existing session-owned Diff RecordStore, referenced by an opaque change ID. Reads bind the desktop session, native Pi identity, project, run and original file index. This persistence is a Friend-Pi adaptation, not a claim about DSH cold-history support. As in the reference, pre-mutation file-tool captures supplement Git-ignored paths and provide comparisons in non-Git directories. Friend limits these captures to the current workspace, after its permission guard; outside-workspace captures are not added. Incomplete existing Git baselines remain unavailable. Git-covered paths restored to their original contents are not re-added from file-tool captures; only ignored workspace paths supplement a valid Git snapshot, excluding gitlinks. File-tool comparisons use jsdiff with a 100ms timeout and an explicit whole-file replacement fallback, following compareText. The existing Pi dependency version (jsdiff 8.0.4, BSD-3-Clause) is pinned as a direct host dependency. Failure flags and original capture mode survive cold resume, with native unavailable summaries fencing incomplete recovery.
- The native Pi SDK remains the sole execution loop/transcript owner. No DSH service, global plugin singleton, API transport, model code, theme, asset, or dependency is imported.

Trajectory reference: timeline.ts maps system/user/context to input, message/compacted to model, and tool/subtool to tools. TrajectoryToolbar toggles equal/recorded-duration overview widths and whole-list turn/call folding; it does not provide three independent width scales. Friend groups native Pi human turns and consecutive parallel tool calls, expands enclosing groups during overview navigation, and uses case-insensitive all-word search over diagnostic native content and IDs. The reference incremental index, virtual ledger and separate inspector are adapted to a local row projection and inline expandable details, without reconstructing missing provider payloads or member transcripts.

Composer monitor reference: StatsPills uses whole-log sessionStats/tokenUsage, weighted decode TPS (provider output tokens / first-content-to-response-end time), prompt-side cache share and mutually exclusive click-open time/usage dialogs. ContextMeter independently shows current estimated context occupancy, with a 200ms hover tooltip and click detail; unknown occupancy is hidden. Stat dialogs use start alignment above the anchor, 8px gap and 12px viewport margin, reposition on scroll/resize/size changes, dismiss outside/Escape.

Friend-Pi uses public getSessionStats() over all native entries for cumulative tokens, including recorded compaction/usage/tool usage; it does not combine independent members or goal budget accounts. Numeric custom metric receipts bind native assistant entry IDs to logical execution turns/steps. Public turn_start records a monotonic request boundary; first nonempty text/thinking/tool data records first content. message_end freezes model timing; turn_end confirms step closure after tools. The installed SDK exposes retry intent on agent_end.willRetry after turn_end: error steps remain open until this decision, and cancelled retry completion closes the final failed step. Auto retries retain logical identity/start while resetting first content for each attempt. The latest receipt replaces the prior attempt for performance/step aggregation: decode TPS uses only the final response content interval, excluding retry backoff and the final attempt's first-token wait; logical model duration and TTFT still include waiting from the original step start. SDK usage retains its native complete totals. Legacy messages use native input ancestry and recorded duration only; they never invent first-token/decode timing. Current context uses the independent public getContextUsage projection; no undocumented component breakdown is manufactured. Normal and conversation-fullscreen composer share the monitor; minimal tool floating composer remains unchanged.
